name: 大唐西游完整修正版
english_name: Great Tang Journey to the West (Complete Revised Edition)
english_description: A Journey to the West-lineage MUD sharing the classic ES II GB/BIG5 encoding-switch mechanism with several sibling archives in this project. Set in the mythological world of Journey to the West — the Thirty-Three Heavens, the Peach Garden, Penglai, the Heavenly Palace — it uniquely asks new players at registration whether they are a primary or secondary school student, and separates ordinary login passwords from a stricter admin password reserved for sensitive account operations.
